messages:
Maya (marketing): Heads-up: we need a quick 1hr scrub on the website onramp copy for the micro-launch next week — focus Hosted / Dedicated / Private value lines + 2 launch posts + webinar hook. Who's free 11:00 today?

Tom (growth): I can make 11. Want to lock the benchmark narrative before posts.

Sarah (content): I'll bring the current copy variants: short headlines + 3 hero CTAs. Sharing doc: https://docs.redwood/brief/onramp-micro

Eli (product): Prefer we align routing: demo vs webinar vs docs. Proposed inbound routing: Hosted -> self-serve flow, Dedicated -> contact sales form, Private -> AE outreach (checkbox).

Maya (marketing): Agree. Also need two 280-char launch posts: product-focused + economics-focused. Tom can draft econ; Sarah takes product tone?

Tom (growth): On it. Will use benchmark stat: '20–40% lower per-token cost vs baseline' — is that safe to publish?

Eli (product): Use 'up to 40%' and link to benchmark page once live. Avoid numbers for Private.

Sarah (content): Copy tweak idea for Dedicated headline: 'Predictable throughput. Dedicated GPUs, predictable bills.' For Hosted: 'Jumpstart with our hosted API — fast to ship.' For Private: 'Bring inference behind your firewall.' Thoughts?

Maya (marketing): :thumbsup: Nice. For hero CTAs, suggest: Hosted: 'Get API key', Dedicated: 'Reserve capacity', Private: 'Talk to sales'

Tom (growth): I'll draft the two posts and a short webinar blurb: 'Live demo + benchmarks + Q&A — 30 mins.'

Eli (product): Routing note: webhook in forms should tag lead.source=website-microlaunch and route Dedicated leads to Tier2 AE.

Sarah (content): I'll push copy edits to doc and add a split-test plan (hero vs cost-led).

Maya (marketing): Great. Final: meet 11:00. @launch-bot schedule standup for 11:00 and ping AEs.

launch-bot: Standup scheduled for 11:00. Meeting link: https://meet.link/abc123
